description: This file defines a TypeScript React component that provides a UI for generating code snippets based on user input, chat history, and selected API configurations. It includes interfaces for parameters, functions for constructing code snippets with various endpoints, and handles different SDKs and endpoint types.

methods.name: generateCodeSnippet
methods.description: Constructs and returns a code snippet string based on input parameters, SDK choice, endpoint type, and chat history, tailored for different API endpoints and SDKs.
